note: The palette CSS is pure-admin-core's own partial, adapted at build time: the component reads only its own --cp-* knobs and the shared --base-* variables (pure-admin's --pc-* / --pa-* layer is resolved to its --base-* fallbacks). Nothing is declared inside the shadow root, so set any of them on :root, an ancestor or the element itself.

baseVariables.name: base-accent-color
baseVariables.usage: Accent: active row tint, focus ring, highlight, primary badge, spinner

baseVariables.name: base-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Dividers (search row, footer, sections) and keycap borders

baseVariables.name: base-border-radius-md
baseVariables.usage: Container corner radius (unitless multiplier of the rem unit)

baseVariables.name: base-border-radius-sm
baseVariables.usage: Row / keycap / badge corner radius (unitless multiplier of the rem unit)

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-base
baseVariables.usage: The search input and its placeholder (default 1.6)

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-lg
baseVariables.usage: Icon-font glyphs (<i>) in the row icon box (default 1.8)

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-xs
baseVariables.usage: Meta text, keycaps, footer hints, context pill (default 1.2)

baseVariables.name: base-rem
baseVariables.usage: Size unit for every rem-based dimension (default 10px; pure-admin hosts set 1rem)

componentVariables.name: cp-backdrop-filter
componentVariables.usage: Backdrop filter (default blur(4px); set none to disable)

componentVariables.name: cp-confirm-min-height
componentVariables.usage: Minimum height of the dialog while it shows the one-line confirmation (the shrink animates down to it). Default 16 × --base-rem

componentVariables.name: cp-highlight-text
componentVariables.usage: Text colour of the <mark> query highlight

componentVariables.name: cp-icon-close
componentVariables.usage: ✕ glyph (token remove, fullscreen close): any url(...). Falls back to --base-icon-close, then an inline Lucide SVG

componentVariables.name: cp-icon-check
componentVariables.usage: ✓ glyph of the confirmation. Falls back to --base-icon-check, then an inline Lucide SVG

componentVariables.name: cp-icon-star
componentVariables.usage: ☆ glyph (favorite toggle, not starred): any url(...). Inline Lucide SVG fallback

componentVariables.name: cp-icon-star-filled
componentVariables.usage: ★ glyph (favorite toggle, starred). Inline Lucide SVG fallback

componentVariables.name: cp-offset-top
componentVariables.usage: Distance of the floating dialog from the top of the viewport

componentVariables.name: cp-results-max-height
componentVariables.usage: Max height of the results list before it scrolls
